encounters.trigger: After defeating Squishy Sprout, the ground hums. A small floating flower drifts down and attaches to the player's inventory. The path ahead reveals a shimmering path leading to the Whispering Woods. The player hears a distant song—a tuba in the distance. This sets up the second encounter.

enemy.name: Tangle-Webbed Spider
enemy.weakness: Bubble Bloom (the hum from the flower causes the spider to tremble and lose 2 HP. When the player activates the Bubble Bloom, the spider freezes mid-spin and can be defeated in one hit). The weakness is tied directly to a pickup from the first encounter. The player must use the Bubble Bloom to defeat it, reinforcing learning from the prior fight.

encounters.hazard: A web of glowing, harmless threads that float and bounce—step on one and you get a soft zap (player only loses 1 health if unprepared, but can avoid it by moving).

pickup.name: Sooty Sap
pickup.effect: A sticky, dark liquid that oozes from a tree. When applied to the ground or used as a potion, it creates a temporary sticky path that slows enemies and can be used to trap the final enemy. Most importantly, it can be used to trigger the boss fight by placing it near a stone altar in the final zone. This is the key to the final boss's weakness—must be used in the final encounter to unlock it.

encounters.trigger: After defeating Tangle-Webbed Spider, the air fills with a low hum. A small sap pool appears near a stone altar. The player sees a mural of a glowing orchid with a note: 'To reach the heart of the jungle, you must gather the final bloom.' The path now leads to the Sooty Cavern, where the final enemy hides.

enemy.name: Gloom Gnome
enemy.weakness: Sooty Sap (when the Gloom Gnome steps on a puddle of Sooty Sap, it turns into a sticky, slow-moving version and loses 3 HP immediately. The player can use the Sooty Sap to create a sticky patch on the floor where the enemy walks, causing a temporary freeze and making it vulnerable). The weakness is tied directly to the second pickup. This makes the fight feel like a puzzle and rewards careful play.

encounters.hazard: The cave floor is slightly slippery when wet—causes a minor slip if not careful. A soft rumble echoes when the Gloom Gnome is near.

pickup.name: Whispering Orchid
pickup.effect: A rare, glowing flower with a soft hum. When placed on a pedestal, it triggers a hidden path to the boss fight. It cannot be used directly in combat, but it is the **only item that weakens the final boss**. This is the critical item from the third encounter. The player must carry it to the final chamber, where it is placed on the altar to unlock the boss fight.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Gloom Gnome, a soft chime echoes. The cave wall slowly shifts, revealing a glowing path. A hidden panel activates: 'The Heart of the Jungle awaits. Place the Whispering Orchid upon the altar to awaken the Keeper of the Bloom.' The player now enters the final chamber.

enemy.name: Keeper of the Bloom
enemy.weakness: Whispering Orchid (if the player places the Whispering Orchid on the central altar, the boss is stunned for 3 seconds and takes 50% damage from all attacks. It must be used during the fight—no other method works. This is the only weakness of the boss and is directly tied to a pickup obtained in the third encounter.)

encounters.hazard: The air hums with magic. If the player leaves the orchid unplaced for more than 10 seconds, the boss becomes immune to all attacks for a short time (a soft warning plays).

pickup.name: Bloom Essence
pickup.effect: A radiant drop of light that recharges the player's vial when placed on a nearby stone. Can be used to heal the player or provide a temporary glow. A reward for completing the journey.

encounters.trigger: The boss is initially dormant. The player must place the Whispering Orchid on the altar to awaken it. Once placed, the boss attacks with slow, dramatic moves—like a floating, glowing creature made of vines and light. It sings a lullaby before charging.

boss.name: Keeper of the Bloom
boss.weakness: Whispering Orchid (must be placed on the altar during the fight to trigger a 3-second stun and 50% damage reduction. This is the only viable weakness and must be obtained from the third encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Place the Whispering Orchid on the altar during the fight, then defeat the boss with normal attacks or a final potion burst using the player's vial.

level.objective: Complete the three encounters and awaken the Keeper of the Bloom by placing the Whispering Orchid on the altar. Use each pickup to unlock the next stage, forming a playful, rewarding chain of discovery.
level.reward: Bloom Essence (for player use), a new alchemical recipe: 'Singing Vine Brew' that gives a 10% chance to make enemies hum when hit, and unlocks a new alchemical skill: 'Humming Shield'.

level.setting: An ancient, overgrown jungle temple beneath a perpetual mist. Trees twist like frozen limbs, paths shift with time, and every few seconds, shadows flicker. Drips echo in silence. A low, mechanical hum pulses through the air — the jungle breathing in slow motion.

enemy.name: Stagnant Warden
enemy.weakness: Chrono-Blade (direct attack during time freeze). When the Warden's time field is active, the blade strikes it in a 3-second temporal burst, causing a 1.5x damage burst and freezing its time field for 2 seconds. The Warden’s time freeze is 5-second bursts, and the player can rewind to avoid attacks during freeze cycles. This creates a time-looped chase scenario where the player must time their moves to land the blade attack during the freeze window.

encounters.hazard: Time freeze zones — when the Warden attacks, all movement slows by 50% for 5 seconds. Player can rewind their actions to reposition or attack.

pickup.name: Fog Shard
pickup.effect: When held, enables 3-second time-dilation (slows time around the player and enemy by 3x). Cannot be used during active freeze. Used in next encounter to counter slow-motion attacks. Obtained when Warden’s time field collapses and a fog vortex erupts, revealing the shard embedded in stone. It is a rare, glowing shard that emits a low hum when active.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Warden, the jungle hums louder. A dark, pulsing ripple appears in the fog — the ground trembles, and a distorted silhouette of a tall, slow-moving creature with elongated limbs emerges from behind a time-fractured tree. This is the Whispering Gloom. A time-echo of the jungle’s corruption now moves toward the player.

enemy.name: Whispering Gloom
enemy.weakness: Fog Shard (active time-dilation). When the player uses the Fog Shard, the Gloom is slowed to 3x in time. Attacks are delayed by 3 seconds, and its shadow moves in slow motion. During this state, the player can time-attack with the Chrono-Blade to land hits that do 2x damage. The Gloom’s attacks are always in slow motion; without the shard, it is immune to damage.

encounters.hazard: The environment is fogged. Vision is reduced to 5 meters. Enemy attacks are always in slow motion. The player must rely on time-dilation to perceive and react to attacks.

pickup.name: Shattered Pulse Shard
pickup.effect: A temporal echo fragment from a broken time-loop. When active, it causes enemy attacks to stutter — every 1.5 seconds, the Gloom or Warden will freeze briefly. Can be used to disrupt loops. Found after defeating the Gloom when a crack in the ground emits a burst of light and shatter — this shard is not usable during time-dilation, but activates when time resumes normally.

encounters.trigger: After the Gloom is defeated, the ground splits open. A pulsing red symbol appears on a stone wall: a time fracture portal. The air grows cold, and the player hears a distorted echo of the Warden’s voice: 'The past is not gone... it’s waiting.' The path leads to a dark chamber — the Chrono-Scar. A glowing red eye pulses from within.

enemy.name: Chrono-Scar
enemy.weakness: Fog Shard (specific pickup from Encounter 1). The Chrono-Scar is formed from the fusion of the Stagnant Warden and the Whispering Gloom. It attacks in three overlapping time loops (3-second cycles). When the player activates the Fog Shard, it causes the Scar to pause in one loop — revealing a moment of stillness where it is vulnerable. The player must hold the Fog Shard during a loop pause to land a critical strike that deals 2x damage and breaks the loop for 10 seconds. The Fog Shard is required to break the loop — without it, the Scar is invincible and regenerates health in loops.

encounters.hazard: The chamber has three time loops. Each loop has a different version of the enemy. The player must track the time loops and time their attacks to land hits during the still moment. If the player fails to hit during a pause, the Scar regenerates health and increases time loop speed.

pickup.name: Temporal Harmony Shard
pickup.effect: Awarded upon defeating the Chrono-Scar. Used to restore time in the jungle — but not usable in the game until the end. A rare reward with lore significance: 'The past and present are one.'

encounters.trigger: The final battle begins only after all three encounters are completed. The player must use the Fog Shard at a critical time point in the Scar’s loop to break its time field. This is the only weakness available. Without the Fog Shard, the boss is invincible and spawns an infinite loop.

boss.name: Chrono-Scar
boss.victory_condition: Land a critical hit with the Chrono-Blade during a time loop pause while the Fog Shard is active. The hit must occur during the moment the Scar is frozen in one of its loops. This breaks the time field, and the boss dies after one successful strike.

level.objective: Destroy the Chrono-Scar by defeating the Stagnant Warden, the Whispering Gloom, and using the Fog Shard to break its time loops. The journey reveals the jungle’s corrupted timeline — time is not just broken, it’s being rewritten.
level.reward: Temporal Harmony Shard (for story progression), unlocks next chapter: 'The Temporal Reckoning'.

level.setting: A desolate, sun-scorched jungle—once vibrant, now reduced to jagged vines, cracked earth, and skeletal trees. The air is thick with silence, broken only by the howl of wind through dry branches. A thin mist clings to the ground, and distant, unnatural sounds echo—like bones grinding beneath foliage. The sun is low, casting long shadows that stretch like fingers across the terrain.

enemy.name: Wraithfang Viper
enemy.weakness: Cracked Obsidian Warhammer (melee attacks cause 150% damage to its tail when swung with force)

encounters.hazard: Toxic Mist Spores

pickup.name: Shard of Thorns
pickup.effect: Grants +30% damage on next melee attack against enemies with 3 or more limbs. Can be used to damage weak points on enemies with exposed limbs (like the Wraithfang’s tail).

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Wraithfang Viper, the ground trembles. Cracks spread through the earth. A low groan echoes, and a blackened root rises from the center of the cleft—cracked and pulsing. A single, jagged vine pulses once, then stills. The screen flickers to a darker tone. The player hears a distant, echoing scream, not from a creature, but from the jungle itself. A faint hum grows louder—like a heartbeat. This prepares the next encounter.

enemy.name: Maw of the Hollow
enemy.weakness: Shard of Thorns (melee attacks using it deal 2x damage to enemies that are in a state of decay or have limbs missing. The Maw’s missing eye socket is exposed and vulnerable when attacked with a weapon that has been used against a limb-removing enemy.)

encounters.hazard: Silent Collapse

pickup.name: Bone-Chime Fragment
pickup.effect: When used, causes a brief audio feedback that triggers a 2-second delay in enemy attack animations. Cannot be used unless the player has previously used the Shard of Thorns in combat.

encounters.trigger: The Hollow groans open. The air grows colder. The Maw’s body is hollowed out, with only a dark, pulsating core visible. A single eye socket glows with red light. After defeating it, a deep, resonant chime echoes through the jungle—longer, deeper. The ground splits, and a thick, black root unfurls upward like a spine. A single, pulsing pulse lights up the far end of the jungle. The player sees a massive, stone-fused structure rising from the ground, cracked and covered in moss. The chime fades—then plays again, more urgently.

enemy.name: The Hollow King
enemy.weakness: Bone-Chime Fragment (activating it during combat causes a 3-second pause in the King’s attack cycle. During that pause, the player can use the Shard of Thorns to strike the King’s exposed spinal node—now glowing crimson. This node is only accessible after the player has used the Bone-Chime Fragment once.)

encounters.hazard: Searing Sunlight

pickup.name: Sun-Cracked Core
pickup.effect: When picked up, the player's health regenerates at 2 per second for 30 seconds. However, each use increases the base damage of the Cracked Obsidian Warhammer by 10% (maximum +40%). This is the final pickup required to defeat the Hollow King.

encounters.trigger: The Spire pulses violently. The sky turns a sickly gray. A massive, humanoid figure made of fused jungle stone and bone emerges from the cracked center. It has no face—only a hole where one should be. Its limbs are fused into jagged spikes. As it stands, it emits a low, resonant hum. The player sees a faint pulse in its spine—matching the frequency of the Bone-Chime Fragment. The final weakness is revealed: if the player activates the Bone-Chime Fragment while holding the Shard of Thorns, the spine node becomes vulnerable. This is the only way to finish it.

boss.name: The Hollow King
boss.weakness: Must use Bone-Chime Fragment to pause attack cycle, then use Shard of Thorns to strike exposed spinal node. The node appears only when the player has used the Bone-Chime Fragment once and is within 2 meters of the enemy. If the player fails to strike it, the King gains 100 health and becomes immune to all limb-based damage for 15 seconds.
boss.victory_condition: Player must trigger the Bone-Chime Fragment, then land a melee hit with the Shard of Thorns on the glowing spinal node. This causes a cascade of fissures to spread across the Spire and the jungle explodes into a final static silence. The screen fades to black with a single, deep chime.

level.objective: Defeat the Hollow King in the Cracked Spire. To do so, the player must survive three brutal encounters, each building on the previous one. The final fight is only possible if the player has acquired the Shard of Thorns, used it to damage a limb-removing enemy, and used the Bone-Chime Fragment to pause the boss's attack. The environment itself becomes hostile and increasingly unstable with each stage.
level.reward: Sun-Cracked Core, and the title: 'Berserker of the Hollowed Jungle'. Upon defeat, the jungle slowly renews—vines bloom, the mist lifts. The player hears a faint, joyful sound in the distance. A new path appears behind the ruins.
